architecture: Native AX trees; tab/snapshot/frame/document/backend-node refs; isolated frame worlds; trusted foreground input; ref-aware flow facade

makeCheck.note: Two external live Rust tests and one opt-in Pi integration test remain opt-in; the dedicated real-browser suite below was run instead.

checks.name: inline same-site, cross-site and nested frame AX labels
native ref input/select/click across frame and nested shadow boundaries
snapshot refs cannot escape their tab or alias a later snapshot
detached/clone replacement refs fail instead of silently retargeting
covered/disabled clicks and invalid selects fail before action
navigation invalidates refs to the old iframe document
file upload uses the same cross-site document-bound refs
default flow observation and ref steps work without frame IDs; failures stop the flow
find, info, wait and scroll use the same refs and report actual scroll boundaries

baseline.note: Eight earlier contract groups were run against the installed release and old extension; the ninth scroll group was added afterward. These are new-contract failures, not eight independently diagnosed old bugs.

paddingRegression.redSignal: A 14px button in an iframe with 9px padding did not receive the click; both raw-ref and flow-ref assertions failed.
paddingRegression.ownerFix: Translate from the iframe content box, accounting for CSS padding as well as border and scale. No click retries.

excluded.reason: Provider rejected this model for the ChatGPT account before inference/tool use.

subagents.method: Only four flow tools. JS, CSS, coordinates and manual frame targeting prohibited; actual tool outputs checked for all three trusted-click fixture markers.
subagents.limitation: Pilot preceded final padding/tiny-target/scroll additions and harness credential-isolation cleanup. Final changes were verified with deterministic browser tests; timing is not a paired performance claim.

deployment.requires: Matching server/extension release, Homebrew upgrade and installed skill synchronization

limits: 64-frame discovery limit and bounded AX output
Refs protect node/document identity, not an atomic semantic transaction over concurrently mutating pages
One valid model trial; unsupported Mini is not counted as a browser failure
